candidate.selection_reason: temporary file descriptor -> links to final path -> potential symlink attacks or path traversal if backupId not properly validated
candidate.source_summary: backupId from RPC parameters -> path = "/var/sandstorm/backups/" + backupId -> finalPath in FileUploadStream constructor
candidate.sink_summary: linkat(AT_FDCWD, "/proc/self/fd/<fd>", AT_FDCWD, finalPath, AT_SYMLINK_FOLLOW) creates hard link from temporary file descriptor to final path
candidate.guard_summary: recursivelyCreateParent creates parent directories but provides no path validation; backupId is not validated with validateId like packageId is in other functions
candidate.risk_pattern: Unvalidated backupId allows path traversal via '../' sequences, enabling arbitrary file write through symlink creation
enclosing_conditions: No validation on backupId parameter before path construction
candidate.context_summary: FileUploadStream creates O_TMPFILE in backup directory parent, then links it to final path; backupId is used directly without validation
unresolved_facts: Whether backupId is validated elsewhere in the call chain
Whether RPC layer provides any backupId validation
Whether backupId format restrictions exist at protocol level

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
target_cwe.description: The product uses external input to construct a pathname that is intended to identify a file or directory that is located underneath a restricted parent directory, but the product does not properly neutralize special elements within the pathname that can cause the pathname to resolve to a location that is outside of the restricted directory. Common in: path_traversal, input_validation.
target_cwe.impact: code execution, data access, data modification
remediation_steps: Validate and sanitize all file paths and names
Use canonical path resolution and access controls

stage3_hypothesis.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
stage3_hypothesis.fit_reason: Unvalidated backupId parameter used in path construction allows '../' sequences to escape backup directory, enabling arbitrary file write via linkat
